title: He Crushed One Bug and Saved a Subway Full of Strangers . . . (Part 1)
caption:
Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint Part 1: Dokja Kim reads the last chapter of his favorite web novel, and it comes true on his subway ride.
A goblin locks the train and says someone has to die. Follow for part 2!

#omniscientreadersviewpoint #manhwarecap #manhwa #webtoon #fyp
comment: Was Dokja right to risk everyone's lives on a box of bugs, or did he just get lucky? Why?

segments.say: Dokja crushes a living bug in his fist, and then he realizes he is *smiling*.
To see how it got here, go back to one *boring* subway ride home from work.
Dokja Kim is twenty-eight, a contract worker with a third-rate degree and no *friends*.
His only hobby is a web novel called *Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse*.
Through school and the army, this one story was the only thing that never *left* him.
He has read it for ten years, and by the end he is the only *reader* left.
So when the epilogue drops today, he sends the author a thank-you *message*.
Then Sanga from work sits next to him, and the whole ride turns *awkward*.
She asks what he is reading, and he lies and says he is studying *Korean*.
He can never tell her this story is the one thing that *saved* him.
He figures Sanga would be the heroine of any novel, and he is just a *reader*.
She says he inspires her, and that is the last *peaceful* moment of his life.
Then his phone buzzes, and the author himself writes back. Dokja nearly *drops* it.
The author says Dokja's comments helped him finish, and he even won a *contest*.
As thanks, he wants to send Dokja a special *present*.
Dokja hopes for a gift card, and five minutes before seven, the present *arrives*.
Then the subway screeches to a halt and every light goes *out*.
At exactly seven, a voice announces that the free service is over and the main scenario will *begin*.
That was the moment the genre of his life *changed*.
Then a fluffy white thing with tiny horns floats in. A *dokkaebi*.
Dokja knows it. This exact creature opens the first page of his novel, and now it is *real*.
Everyone else thinks it is a movie shoot, but Dokja knows better and tells Sanga not to *move*.
The dokkaebi asks for quiet. Then two people turn into *paint*.
Then a man in a suit waves cash and offers the goblin *millions* to let him out.
Money is great, the dokkaebi agrees, and then he blows up the man's *hand*.
Turns out money means *nothing* in the dokkaebi's world.
Then the first main scenario drops: *kill* a living thing in thirty minutes, or die.
Sanga calls the police, but nobody *answers*, so the cabin is on its own.
Dokja finally says it out loud: this is a game now, and every game has *rules*.
Then an army lieutenant named Hyeonseong Lee steps up and takes *charge*.
Dokja freezes. That man was not supposed to show up until *after* the first scenario.
The news calls it terrorism, but the dokkaebi cuts in, and the speech ends in *blood*.
Next, he gets bored and cuts the time limit from thirty minutes to *ten*.
If nobody dies in five minutes, everyone in the cabin *dies*.
Dokja's story is turning out different from the one he remembers, and that scares him *more*.
Then he sees the author's present is a file, and it holds the *whole* novel.
He opens it, a skill kicks in, and he reads at main-character *speed*.
Their cabin is 3807, but the hero's cabin in the story is 3707, right *behind* them.
He remembers the line: in this cabin, only two people will *live*.
Then a white-haired kid named Namwoon Kim grabs a man and starts *beating* him.
Next he drags an old lady forward and says someone has to *die*.
Some people join in, others just *watch*, and nobody stops him.
Dokja has read this page before, and he knows the old lady is the first *victim*.
Cold, but honestly he was *right*.
Sanga runs to help her, and Dokja yanks her *back*.
He begs her to stay put and promises to explain *later*.
Because he is not scared. He is just waiting for the right *moment*.
Boom. A blast fills the cabin with smoke, and Dokja goes full Naruto-*running*.
He slams Namwoon into the wall, and Namwoon asks what his *problem* is.
But saving the old lady was never the *real* plan.
He pushes through the smoke to a little boy hugging a box of *insects*.
Then he shouts to the whole cabin: fine, kill the old lady. Then *what*?
Who do you kill next? The person beside you? Namwoon just *laughs*.
Dokja says there is a way to live without becoming a *murderer*.
The scenario said kill a living organism, not a *human*.
He pulls a cricket from the box, and the whole cabin finally gets it.
Now the same mob that wanted the old lady's blood charges at *him*.
And weirdly, his heart pounds with joy. He cannot stop *smiling*.
Crunch. The first kill is *cleared*, and the system pays him a hundred extra coins.
Everyone scrambles for the last bugs, and the clock says three minutes *left*.
Namwoon strolls over. There were only three bugs, so why did you hand them *out*?
Dokja just says yes. Namwoon cracks up, because no sane person pulls that *stunt*.
Namwoon Kim is nineteen, cruel, and has waited for the apocalypse his whole *life*.
Dokja's new skill flashes his profile, and the word on it is *edgelord*.
Now the most dangerous kid in the cabin wants to team up with Dokja, with two minutes on the *clock*.
